text:
tara.docs: opened PR #981 to simplify the quota examples page. Replaced the long hypothetical tables with compact per-1k-token cost examples and a short worked example. Diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/981

ben: nice. can you also collapse the repeated 'burst credit' footnotes? they make the table noisy on mobile.

tara.docs: yes — converting the footnotes into a single expandable FAQ block. that should help mobile flow.

indra: Heads-up: the old external link from the billing FAQ points at /docs/pricing#old-tiers which 404s now. please add a redirect or update the billing FAQ link.

tara.docs: added a redirect mapping in _redirects for that anchor and swapped the billing FAQ link to point at /docs/quota#credits. sample rule added: "#/docs/pricing#old-tiers  /docs/quota#credits  301"

samir: SDK snippets: I noticed the ruby sample still used the legacy client API. Suggest replacing with client.responses.create and a short note about handling 429 with Retry-After.

tara.docs: good catch — updated ruby and node snippets and added a tiny retry snippet.

ben: quick editorial nit: changed "units" to "tokens" in the worked example so it matches the calculator.

ci-bot: preview build queued for branch docs/quota-compact. status: running.

ci-bot: preview succeeded — https://deploy-preview-981--docs.redwood.ai. Anchors resolve, snippets render, and redirect test passed.

indra: LGTM. I'll notify support to update saved links.

tara.docs: merging in 5m unless anyone objects. thank you!
